Thanks again for the call today, Alex — really appreciate the context on your user flows and expected peak traffic. Based on what we covered, I think the best next step is a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) where our SE can walk through throughput/latency assumptions and we can align on concurrency, token budgets, and KV cache expectations.

Proposed agenda (30-45 min):
- Quick recap of your traffic profile (concurrency, request sizes)
- Target latency SLOs (p50/p95/p99) and success criteria
- Sizing exercise: expected RPS, average tokens per request, batching strategy
- Recommended Dedicated config and quantization options
- Next steps & timeline for a pilot/POC

Attachments: I’m attaching our dedicated sizing template to capture the inputs before the meeting — if you can populate the shaded fields ahead of time that will make the call more efficient.

Please share 2-3 windows that work for you next week and I’ll get something on the calendar. We can include your infra lead if helpful.
